Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side after internal check:

1) PO threshold: We generally issue POs for purchases > $25,000. Card payments are fine for ad-hoc purchases below that.
2) Budget owners / approvers:
   - Economic buyer: Maya Patel (VP, Product) - owns budget and decision for pilot scope.
   - Finance sponsor: Liam Chen (Director, Finance) - handles PO issuance and vendor onboarding.
   - Signatory path: CFO signs anything > $100k; for pilots and POs under $100k, VP-level sign-off is acceptable per our internal policy.
3) Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace for productized offerings because procurement can be faster there; however, for pilots we often do direct vendor PO/invoice so we can manage scopes and trial terms.
4) Timing: We are aiming to kick procurement week of 4/12; ideally have a PO in place by end of April.

I attached our internal PO process PDF for your finance team. Happy to set up the procurement sync - Wed 4/14 at 11am PT works for me.

Sam
